stem: Arjun wants to strengthen the transition between the second paragraph (sentences 5–6) and the third paragraph (sentences 7–13). Which sentence should replace sentence 7 to provide a better transition?

options.label: A
options.text: Additionally, the orchid garden of Las Pozas was a failure.

options.label: B
options.text: But what would happen to the orchid garden of Las Pozas?

options.label: C
options.text: Sadly, the orchid garden of Las Pozas was not destined to last.

options.label: D
options.text: The orchid garden of Las Pozas drew a lot of attention.
